svg.title: EOL testing — Prometheus on a rail

g.text: Prometheus on a linear rail tends all six testers
Same testers, same totes, same flow. The robot takes over the pick · scan · load · sort cycle on both sides of the aisle.
does the work of three operators.
robot rides the rail and turns its torso to serve both rows

text.tspan: — drawer in, test runs under 1 min
— next device waits on top of the tester
